title: Alex Bregman 2024 Topps #CSMLB-59 Stars of MLB Chrome Houston Astros
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024 Topps #CSMLB-59 Stars of MLB Chrome trading card featuring Alex Bregman of the Houston Astros. The card is part of the set and is a parallel/variety of the Stars of MLB Chrome insert set. It is a sports trading card for baseball fans and collectors alike, and is manufactured by Topps. The card is not autographed and is from the 2024 season. It is a great addition to any collection and perfect for fans of the Houston Astros and Alex Bregman.
